6754-7084-7272.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
6754-7084-7272.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Eusocial Engineering triggers, creating a 2/2 colorless Robot artifact creature token
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

628-3899-6972.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken non-Human creature with base toughness 2 or greater.
628-3899-6972.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another nontoken non-Human creature
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Spawning Pit abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
628-3899-6972.notes: If the creature being used starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

1981-2034-2415-4699.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}
When the creature dies, Overgrowth Elemental and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2438-3188.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2438-3188.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1368-3755-4742-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-3755-4742-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2376-5686--5.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Rhythm of the Wild
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

1887-3099-4762-5902.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Innkeeper's Talent and Vorinclex.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

2961-3175-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, False Demise triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-6965-7353.easyPrerequisites: Opponents have at least two creature cards in their graveyards.
3259-6965-7353.notablePrerequisites: Opponents with creature cards in their graveyards cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6965-7353.description:
Deal combat damage using Shark Shredder and the creature with Breath of Fury attached. Shark Shredder and Breath of Fury trigger.
Resolve the Shark Shredder trigger, putting a creature card from the defending player's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature put onto the battlefield in step 2, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-6965-7353.notes: If there happens to be two or more creatures with haste in opponents' graveyards, you can omit Frostcliff Siege so long as both Shark Shredder and the creature with Breath of Fury attached do not have summoning sickness.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

2034-2646-4559-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
2034-2646-4559-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

5075-6798-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
5075-6798-7084.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Ogre Slumlord and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

1170-4668-5078-6979.easyPrerequisites: You have not cast a spell using The Fourth Doctor this turn If Sensei's Divining Top is on top of your library.
1170-4668-5078-6979.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
1170-4668-5078-6979.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, and The Fourth Doctor triggers if you had cast Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking The Fourth Doctor.
Resolve the Fourth Doctor trigger, if applicable, creating a Food token.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

864-1987-7089.notablePrerequisites: You control three permanents that enter untapped and that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
864-1987-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, activate three permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, targeting the tapped permanent and Eternal Witness.
Fire Lord Azula triggers, copying Ghostly Flicker, targeting two other mana-producing permanents
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking the two targeted permanents.
Resolve the original Ghostly Flicker, blinking the targeted permanent and Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

338-2034-4365-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
338-2034-4365-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

618-3967-4783.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Hellkite Courser with haste.
The Hellkite Courser token enters the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki.
Choose to return Kiki-Jiki to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Yahenni trigger from step 3.
Resolve the Hellkite Courser trigger from step 2, putting Kiki-Jiki from the command zone onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3899-3921-4324-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Workshop Elders
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

856-2558-5231-6748.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
856-2558-5231-6748.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, which is a Food due to Ragost, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Sword of the Meek trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Sword of the Meek trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Repeat.

2459-4763-5231--21.description:
Activate the Equipment by paying its equip cost, attaching it to Rograkh.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Rograkh, adding {R}.
When Rograkh dies, Koll triggers, returning Rograkh from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Rograkh by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1017-3532-5078-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
1017-3532-5078-6747.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1976-5078-6918.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

1060-4083-6899.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal damage to Sun-Crowned Hunters.
Sun-Crowned Hunters is indestructible.
1060-4083-6899.description:
Deal damage to Sun-Crowned Hunters.
Sun-Crowned Hunters and Repercussion trigger.
Resolve the Sun-Crowned Hunters trigger, dealing damage to an applicable target.
Resolve the Repercussion trigger, dealing damage to Sun-Crowned Hunters instead of you due to With Great Power....
Repeat from step 2.

2511-6871-6879-6880.description:
Cast Stonework Puma by paying {3}.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Stonework Puma.
When Stonework Puma dies, Haru triggers, returning Stonework Puma from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3755-4222-6859.description:
Activate Servant of Tymaret by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Servant of Tymaret.
Servant of Tymaret triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain that much life.
Repeat.

934-1399-1606-3664.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Lotus Field.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature with MV=1 and Creates Creature Token(s) on Death

2034-2178-6542--110.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with mana value 0.
2034-2178-6542--110.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with mana value 0.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning the creature that creates creature token(s) on death from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, it and Sidisi trigger.
Resolve the Sidisi trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the creature's trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Repeat.

1737-2793-4779.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {5} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Ugin's Nexus.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by acrificing the Ugin's Nexus token.
The Ugin's Nexus token is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat each turn.

1744-2699-2836-3994.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two other Golems on the battlefield.
1744-2699-2836-3994.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, targeting Precursor Golem.
Precursor Golem's second ability triggers, creating a kicked copy of Rite of Replication targeting every other Golem.
Resolve the first Rite of Replication, creating five token copies of the Golem it is targeting.
If the Golem was Percursor Golem, the Percursor Golem tokens enter the battlefield, triggering their first abilities, creating a total of ten 3/3 Golem artifact creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3 for each other Rite of Replication.
Cast Aggressive Urge by paying {G}, targeting any Golem.
The six Percursor Golems' second abilities each trigger, creating six copies of Aggressive Urge targeting every other Golem.
Resolve the first Aggressive Urge, giving target creature +1/+1 and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat step 8 until you draw from an empty library, causing you to win the game.

1849-3259-3973-4050.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four permanents of any color on the battlefield.
Breath of Fury attached to any creature you control except Rith.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1849-3259-3973-4050.description:
Deal combat damage using Rith and the creature with Breath of Fury attached, triggering Rith and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Rith trigger, causing you to pay {2}{G} to create at least four 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Saproling token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase, and deal combat damage using Rith and the creature with Breath of Fury attached, triggering Rith and Breath of Fury.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Saprolings, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

231-2210-3281-3390.description:
Activate Lotus Bloom by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W} or {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Mirrormade by paying {1}{U}{U}, having it enter the battlefield as a copy of Great Furnace.
Activate Mirrormade by tapping it, adding {R}.
Activate Tameshi's second ability by paying {W} and returning Mirrormade from the battlefield to your hand, returning Lotus Bloom from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1318-2787.notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {U}{U}.
Echo Mage has at least four level counters on it.
1318-2787.description:
Cast Reins of Power by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Holding priority, activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Echo Mage by paying {U}{U} and tapping it, copying Reins of Power twice.
Resolve the first copy of Reins of Power, untapping all creatures you and target opponent control, and exchanging control of those creatures.
Resolve the second copy of Reins of Power, untapping all creatures you and target opponent control, and exchanging control of those creatures, causing you to regain control of all the creatures you originally controlled.
Repeat from step 2.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana.

128-4613-4774-5296.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one card in hand.
Workhorse has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
128-4613-4774-5296.description:
Activate Workhorse using Pack Rat' ability by paying {3} and discarding a card, creating a token copy of it.
When the Workhorse token enters the battlefield, Elemental Bond triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate the Workhorse token three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1283-2440-4770.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cat.
1283-2440-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {2}.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Cat you control.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
If you control at least two Cats outside of Whitemane Lion, this combo nets infinite mana.

396-1409-2557-4050.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with another creature.
396-1409-2557-4050.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability and Blessed Sanctuary triggers.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and another creature you control.
Resolve the Blessed Sanctuary trigger, creating two 2/2 Unicorn creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Unicorns, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

466-2034-4616.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
466-2034-4616.description:
Activate Saproling Cluster by paying {1} and discarding a card, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
When the Saproling dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card.
Repeat.

3903-4422.notablePrerequisites: Curse of Exhaustion attached to an opponent.
3903-4422.description:
Whenever the opponent with Curse of Exhaustion attached casts a spell from their hand, Knowledge Pool triggers, exiling that spell.
Because Curse of Exhaustion prevents the opponent from casting more than one spell each turn, the opponent cannot cast the spell permitted by Knowledge Pool, or any other spell that turn.

1170-2566-3634.description:
Cast any other spell by paying its mana cost, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
If the spell is a noncreature spell that you cast, Displacer Kitten triggers.
Holding priority, cast Pact of Negation by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Venser.
Venser enters the battlefield, returning Pact of Negation to your hand.
Repeat from step 3.

765-1479-2374.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
765-1479-2374.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it, Maja, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Maja trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Maja trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
